# Kairo

> Booking, payments and client-messaging software for businesses that sell appointments. One-off AUD $410 setup fee, no monthly subscription and no commission. Built and proven in a working business in Melbourne, Australia.

Kairo replaces the paper diary, the card machine and the separate reminder app with one system on one login. It runs the appointment calendar, client records, point of sale, retail stock, automatic client messaging and a public booking page on the business's own branded link.

The reason to put them together is time. Most of the admin in an appointment business happens in the gaps — chasing a confirmation, retyping a booking into a second system, remembering who to tell when something moves. Kairo does those automatically, so the gaps go back into the day.

Two facts distinguish it from general booking platforms. Each business gets its own separate database rather than a row in a shared one, so the client list is structurally its own. And the booking page is the business's own link rather than a listing in a marketplace that also shows competitors.

## Price

- One-off setup fee: AUD $410, including GST, paid once before setup.
- Monthly subscription: none.
- Per-booking fee: none.
- Commission on services or retail: none.
- Outside that: your own payment-processing fees, which go to your payment provider, and hardware.
- Refund: full refund within 30 days of going live, no justification required.

## Who it is for

Any business that runs on booked appointments: hair, barbering, beauty, nails and lashes, clinics and therapists, studios, and trades that work to a schedule. Currently sold in Australia.

## What it does

- Appointment diary with a column per person that cannot be double-booked, and blocks the real length of each job.
- Service menu priced the way the work actually prices: fixed, "from" for anything that varies by job, and free for consultations.
- Client records with visit history and service notes, including any safety or allergy details.
- Automatic confirmations, reminders, reschedule and cancellation notices and receipts, by email or SMS, each one logged with its delivery status.
- Public booking page on the business's own link, offering only genuine openings.
- Point of sale and invoicing, with card payments processed by Stripe.
- Retail stock tracked against margin, with low-stock warnings.
- Automatic review requests after a visit, collected on the business's own page.
- A list of clients who have quietly stopped booking, ready to message.
- Reporting on bookings by hour, revenue per day and top services.
- The full workspace on a phone, installable to the home screen — no separate cut-down app.

## Data and privacy

- Customer data is stored in Australia.
- Each business has its own database; no query can return another business's records.
- Client names, contact details, history and notes belong to the business. Kairo holds them as a service provider on that business's instructions, never markets to a customer's clients, and never sells client data.
- A full data export is available on request at any time.
- Card numbers are not stored by Kairo; payments go through Stripe.

## Contact

There is a contact form on kairobookings.com, or email enquiries@kairobookings.com directly. Either way, include the business name, what the business does, team size and a phone number, and a walkthrough is arranged from there.
